evidence.detail: The class parses the skybox mapping DSL with the same bounds, m/r/R/c/C region/chunk selectors, #RGB/#RRGGBB colors, plane masks and blend-radius directives, including the exact named regex groups mrx/mry/rx/ry/cx/cy/color/plane/blend.

It encodes colors into YCoCg, stores per-chunk and plane-override data, maps instance template chunks through a three-int callback, applies Gaussian/error-function spatial blending, converts back to RGB and applies HSB brightness.
It exposes InputStream/String and Reader/String constructors and can render its skybox map into a BufferedImage for inspection.
The adjacent exact-v308 wrapper constructs this class from the bundled resource skybox.txt, fixing the data domain independently of the parser shape.

The public RuneLite-derived source preserves class Skybox with matching constructors, ChunkMapper callback, parser grammar, YCoCg encoding, plane overrides, Gaussian blend calculation and BufferedImage render path.

candidates.note: Skybox is corroborated by the exact-v308 parser/render contract and a matching public RuneLite-derived Skybox implementation. Exact v308 remains the semantic authority.
